delete.description:
Delete every audio file. Documents and scripts stay, and each audio's job
becomes cancelled so a retry narrates its saved script again.

post.description:
Download a zip of the library: database, audio files and settings
without API keys or the access token.

Replace the library with a backup's. This installation's API keys,
access token, endpoints, provider, voice engine, access mode and watched
folder are kept. The queue is paused so restored jobs wait for Resume.
Check a backup and report what it holds. Nothing changes.

patch.description: Partial update: only the fields sent are saved; `null` clears a saved value.

get.description:
Work done today: the calendar day at `utc_offset_minutes` (default UTC).

Browsers can send `-new Date().getTimezoneOffset()`.
